description: a team united to write stories while describing the world and the universe
summary: As the Mechanix team, we have developed a digital children's book. Through this project, we aim to help young children learn more about space; specifically, we have crafted a story that introduces the various space instruments—tools that have been instrumental in our exploration of the cosmos—to highlight just how vital they truly are. This subject is of great importance to us, because if we forget the research conducted in the past, we will have no foundation upon which to build future scientific inquiry.
details:
Our project was created to highlight the importance of curiosity from an early age and to provide information about space.

In this digital book project, which aims to foster a sense of inquiry and curiosity in young children, we also share facts about space.

The narrative and the content were developed entirely by our team; we only consulted NASA’s official website for specific, detailed information.

As a team, we took great care to craft the story in a way that ensures a positive experience for children, as we believe that pedagogical considerations are the most important aspect. Thank you very much for reading our digital book.
